# 0.5.17

## 本次更新

- 修复推荐页显示缓存后无法继续加载的问题，后续页面会在首屏加载完成后正常触发。
- 修复快速滑动后惯性触底不加载的问题，下拉刷新与加载更多互不干扰。
- 底部加载和错误提示改为整行显示，加载失败可重试并保留已有作品。
- 分页异常不再误显示为已加载全部，新增脱敏日志便于排查。

## What's New

- Fixed recommendation pagination getting stuck after cached content appears; subsequent pages can load once the live first page finishes.
- Fixed fast flings not triggering pagination; pull-to-refresh and load-more stay independent.
- Loading and error feedback now spans the feed width; failed pages can be retried while keeping loaded artwork.
- Pagination errors no longer appear as the end of the feed, with sanitized diagnostics added for troubleshooting.
